verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents a static API reference (HTTP, Pixel, Transformations, Audit Logs APIs), but nothing shows the reference is interactive or has runnable 'try it' examples, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec. The Event Playground app sends sample events to test data flow, which is an adjacent testing tool rather than an interactive API reference, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
